newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen steady after elections.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen steady after elections.

text.p: Jakarta stocks were seen steady on Monday on an expected continued wave of optimism after last week's general elections and announcements of healthy first quarter results, brokers said.
"The relatively smooth elections coupled with reports of some encouraging Q1 results are likely to keep sentiment firm," one broker said.
Telkom, the biggest capitalised stock on the Jakarta stock exchange, announced last week strong first quarter results, brokers said.
Stocks which were likely to attract market attention include tyre maker Gajah Tunggal and tyre cord manufacturer Andayani following announcements of first quarter results.
The Jakarta Composite Index closed 0.95 percent higher at 696.03 points on Friday.

Surya Semesta topped the active list, with some 36 million shares traded on intense market talk of a possible bid for a stake in the small property firm and speculation of higher profits this year, brokers said.
Surya Semesta rose 100 rupiah to 1,200 rupiah.
Garment firm Karwell was also active ahead of its shareholders' meeting on June 23 and also on market talk that a foreign firm would buy a stake in the company, brokers said.
Karwell rose 150 rupiah to 1,200 rupiah, with some 11 million shares traded.
